about: Real humid-heat (46 C / 0.95) baseline/final observations of 5 acolytes x 12 repeats, recorded with tools/record_physiology_heat_fixture.py at the revision below. Each unit carries its core temperature, hyperthermia meter, the engine heat-balance read (thermo.readHeatBalance) and the cumulative executed-step ledger at both snapshots. Used by tools/test_physiology_probe.py to prove that the probe's expected rise agrees with the rise the engine produced.
